reason: I'm under $5k a month and already pay a setter, so $147 plus a card up front for something with zero customer results isn't a casual try. Sending from my own Instagram through an extension is the part that scares me, because if my account gets restricted I lose my whole pipeline.
objection: Will this get my Instagram restricted or banned? The page tells me how it works but never says the account is safe, and the 'payments are final after day 3' rule means I'd be stuck if it goes wrong. There are also no results from anyone yet and 7 of 100 seats taken doesn't prove anything.
would_change_my_mind: Real results from a few agency owners my size, such as booked calls from a month of use with their accounts still fine, plus a no-card trial or a refund window so I can test it on a secondary account first.
